note: National retailer cards use ltk_url for Shop This Deal and deal_url for See all Black Friday deals. Local cards leave ltk_url empty and keep Shop the Deal on deal_url. Prices were checked Nov 24, 2026.

deals.deal: Black Friday deals run Nov 22–29, 2026, with more weekend deals Nov 26–29. Target says shoppers can save up to 50% on thousands of gifts. The Yulee store follows chain hours: closed Thanksgiving, open at 6 a.m. local time on Nov 27 and closing at its regular time. The first 100 eligible guests in line get a Target GiftCard of $25, $50, $100, or, for one guest per store, $1,000. Official rules are on Target’s giveaway page.
deals.featured_product: LEGO Star Wars SMART Play: AT-ST Attack on Endor 75424

deals.deal: Walmart’s Black Friday deals run Nov 23–29, 2026. Online starts at 12:01 a.m. ET on Nov 23. In stores, the event opens Nov 27 at 6 a.m. local time. U.S. stores are closed Thanksgiving. Walmart says hours may vary by location, so check the Yulee store before you drive.
deals.location: Walmart Supercenter, 464016 State Road 200 E, Yulee, FL 32097

deals.deal: The named Black Friday Savings Event is Nov 5–25, 2026, so it ends the day before Thanksgiving. Home Depot’s Oct 29 announcement includes select power-tool BOGOs (RYOBI, Milwaukee, DEWALT) and holiday décor prices such as 6.5-foot pre-lit trees at $49.98. Offers vary by store. Separately, the holiday-hours page says stores are closed Thanksgiving and open at 6 a.m. on Nov 27. The Yulee store’s regular Monday–Saturday hours already start at 6 a.m.
deals.featured_product: 7.5 ft Realistic Hinged Prelit Artificial Christmas Tree with Foot Pedal, 600 Warm Lights

deals.deal: Amazon’s Black Friday Week runs through Nov 30, 2026. The company says new daily deal drops continue through that date, and Today’s Big Deals include savings of up to 60% off, posted twice on Black Friday (midnight and 8 a.m. PST). Deals change and sell out. There is no Amazon store in Nassau County; this is the online sale.

Best Buy’s Black Friday sale started Nov 19, 2026. The sale page says Black Friday deals and doorbusters end Nov 28 at 11:59 p.m. CT. The Nov 17 announcement lists Black Friday store hours of 6 a.m.–10 p.m., and says hours may vary. In store on Nov 27, My Best Buy members can buy a $100 Best Buy gift card for $60 while limited quantities last. There is no Best Buy in Nassau County. The nearest stores are in Jacksonville.
deals.location: Online, or Best Buy stores in Jacksonville

deals.deal: Kohl’s Black Friday Week is Nov 22–28, 2026. The company says many deals start at 50% off, stores open at 5 a.m. local time on Nov 27, and the first 200 shoppers that morning receive Kohl’s Cash of $5 to $100 while supplies last. Online doorbusters start at 12:01 a.m. CT on Thanksgiving. No Kohl’s store was confirmed in Nassau County. Kohl’s own site blocked an automated check, so the verified page is this corporate announcement.
deals.location: Online. No Nassau County store confirmed.
